description: C1 infinity step 3 (bean qou-odh5). Two-pole Prony resolves the q-Borel singularity structure into an EXACT ANTIPODAL PAIR xi = +/- 2.36510358..., sum zero to 21 digits, branch-independent to 2.2e-29. This corrects step 2's reading of a 3.7e-4 'branch spread' as two nearby singularities: that was a single-pole ratio test blending one antipodal pair. The +/- matches the leading blocks B = +/- sqrt(q-1)/q. |xi| is normalisation-dependent and is NOT identified; xi_2/xi_1 = -1 is the canonical datum. Multipliers not extracted.
